name: sonic_mobility
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a smooth authored Neo Geo pixel sprite ANIMATION sheet based on this exact approved modular tank kit. Keep fixed overhead camera, DOWN-facing chassis, same palette, same bolts/sockets/proportions. Transparent RGBA, absolutely no checkerboard/background/ground or surrounding colored fog. EXACT FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS, 32 cells, wide gutters of transparent pixels. Each cell same size, fixed anchor. TOP FOUR ROWS (frames1-16) show ONLY the bare central HULL from row1 column2 of the reference. No weapons, no tracks, no sensor mounted. Animate only small radiator shutters, engine status lights and heat shimmer internal to metal; hull/frame never slides, rotates, resizes or bobs. Empty circular weapon sockets stay exactly aligned. BOTTOM FOUR ROWS (frames17-32) show ONLY a matched LEFT AND RIGHT TRACK PAIR, with EMPTY transparent space where the entire hull would be. Take the track parts from row1 columns3 and4, arrange them correctly either side of the missing hull at the same scale as the first16 hulls. Animate tread belt links moving16 very small consecutive phases while upper armored track guards stay pixel-locked. Both tread units remain separate, never a central hull connecting them. 16 consecutive phases that loop seamlessly. Preserve every original crisp dark outline and chrome highlight. Do not repeat identical frames: depict authentic subtle successive internal movement. Keep each whole sprite within its cell with at least20px clear margin; no part may cross gutters. No text. Tank identity: sonic. Platinum/graphite with cyan equipment; absolutely remove the reference's surrounding dark haze.
